notes.title: New feature “Orb of the End” implemented!
notes.content:
[Orb of the End]
<How to obtain>
- Obtained when clearing the Claws world for the second time or later.
- There are two types, W (weapon) and R (magic equipment), which can be obtained randomly.
- You can only have one of each.

<Fusion conditions & fusion method>
- Enhance Orb of the End to the maximum and select the status on the details screen of the soldier whose front and back status are maxed out.
- Can be filled up to the maximum number of fusions.

<Fusion effect>
- HP, SP, Atk, Def, Tec increased by +1. (W and R both have the same fusion effect)

notes.title: ＜Ver 1.49＞スキル覚醒を追加
notes.content:
＜Ver 1.49＞
・兵士詳細画面：スキルレベル最大時（システム上の）、黄★を表示
・「スキル覚醒」機能を追加
　兵士詳細でスキルレベルMAXのスキルをクリックすると、スキルを覚醒し、更にレベルを上げることができる。
　（但し、システム上の最大レベルは越えられない。例えば Angel Heart の最大レベルは9）

<Ver 1.49>
-Soldier details screen: When the skill level is maximum (on the system), yellow ★ is displayed.
-Added "skill awakening" function
If you click the skill of skill level MAX in the soldier details, you can awaken the skill and raise the level further.
(However, the maximum level on the system cannot be exceeded. For example, the maximum level of Angel Heart is 9.)

notes.title: Ver 1.48
notes.content:
-Added the function of config.txt (located in the same location as the game executable file)
KEY_UDLR = OFF ... Disable the up / down / left / right keys on the keyboard (for when it responds even though it is not pressed)
PAD = OFF ... Disable pad operation (for when it reacts even though it is not pressed)

・config.txt（ゲームの実行ファイルと同じ場所にあります）の機能を追加
KEY_UDLR=OFF ... キーボードの上下左右キーを無効化（押してないのに反応してしまう時用）
PAD=OFF ... パッドでの操作を無効化（押してないのに反応してしまう時用）
